$comment: p15-oracle-068: the git, project and stash families' 18 mutations (gen_daemon_ops.py reads this file; run it after an edit). Every git case runs on tests/oracle/fixtures/git/oracle.json, which the driver builds under $CASE_ROOT/repos before the first step (fixture.repo): fixed commit dates, a bare origin under the case root as its only remote. A git call names its repository by path, so its target has no workspace selector (git_ops/target.rs refuses a path with a selector). The project store refuses every path under /tmp (state/projects.rs Refusals), and every case root is under /tmp/o, so project cases name a project the store only records (observe reads no disk), as cmux-tui/tests/projects_daemon.rs does; project.add, which needs an existing folder, cannot succeed yet. The stash cases stash the app-drawn http page of the standard fixture (fx-stash).

success.note: a checkpoint of the fixture checkout: its unstaged notes.txt edit and the untracked scratch.txt; HEAD, the index and the files stay as they are

error.note: path is empty (value has too few UTF-8 bytes); the daemon's catalog check refuses it before any git runs

success.note: pins the checkpoint the before step made; a pinned record is never pruned

error.note: a checkpoint id the repository has no record of (git_ops/checkpoint.rs not_found)

success.note: removes the pin the before step set; the checkpoint stays

error.note: a handoff: pin is managed: only its owner releases it (git_ops/checkpoint.rs MANAGED_PINS)

untested: the new commit's id and dates: git.commit runs git with every inherited GIT_* variable dropped (git_ops/user_run.rs), so its dates are the wall clock's; the case asserts the receipt, and the repository's own config gives the identity and turns signing and hooks off
success.note: commits the fixture's unstaged notes.txt edit, staging it first

error.note: with neither paths nor all the index is committed as it is, and the fixture stages nothing (git_ops/commit.rs classified)

success.note: main tracks origin/main, one commit behind: the push fast-forwards the fixture's bare origin under the case root, its only remote

error.note: a remote name the repository does not configure; the daemon never takes a URL (git_ops/push.rs), so nothing is contacted

success.note: the fixture's linked worktree on cmux/feature (base main recorded as git.worktree.create records it) has one commit adding feature.txt, which lands in the main checkout as an uncommitted file

error.note: the main checkout is no linked worktree: there is nothing to apply it to (git_ops/worktree_apply.rs)

success.note: a worktree ~/.cmux/worktrees/oracle/oracle (HOME is the case's) on the new branch cmux/oracle from main

error.note: a base that names no commit (git_ops/worktree.rs plan)

success.note: removes the clean worktree the before step made; its branch has no commit main lacks, so the branch goes too

error.note: the fixture's feature worktree has one commit on no other branch and no remote; without discard nothing is removed

success.gap: no case folder is one the project store takes: every case root is under /tmp (oracle.py DEFAULT_STATE_BASE /tmp/o, spec 3G) and state/projects.rs Refusals refuses every path under /tmp, /var/folders and the home folder (validation.invalid refused_path); p15-oracle-244 gives a case a folder outside those roots for project.add
success.note: adds the fixture checkout, an existing folder, as the user's project

error.note: a relative path: the store takes only an absolute folder (state/projects_ops.rs state_project_add)

success.note: the source oracle reports a folder; the store reads no disk for a report, so the path only has to be absolute and outside the refused roots
the source still reports the project, so it is hidden, not deleted

error.note: a path the store has no project for

success.note: turning the reporting source off takes it off every project it reported
the app found the folder gone; a source other than the user still reports it, so it stays present
the user's rename of a project a source reported

error.note: an unknown path is validation.invalid with unknown_project (the catalog's constraint)

success.note: stashes the app-drawn http page; a terminal tab would refuse the request (state/stash.rs: only web pages)
deletes the whole stash fx-stash made
one OneTab group with one loopback http page becomes one stash (an about:blank page is not kept)
reopens the stashed page here, in its pane, and the emptied stash goes
